name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
summary: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India.
summary_hi: भारत के सभी भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की आय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली योजना।
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts of eligible farmers
Amount released in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months

who_can_apply: All landholding farmer families in India
Families with land recorded in state land records
who_cannot_apply: Professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, architects, chartered accountants)
Current and former mayors/chairpersons of municipalities
Farmers who voluntarily surrendered their land
documents_required: Land documents (Record of Rights / Khatauni / 7/12 extract)
Mobile phone number linked to Aadhaar

eligibility_rules.fail_msg: PM-KISAN is for farmers with landholding
IT payers/professionals may not be eligible

application_process.how_to_apply: The scheme is centrally administered but state governments identify and register beneficiaries based on land records. Farmers do not need to individually apply in most cases — names are automatically included if land records are updated.
if_not_included: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or agriculture department office
Provide land documents and Aadhaar to get registered
Check status online at pmkisan.gov.in using Aadhaar number or bank account details
If land records are not updated, approach the local Tehsildar/Patwari for correction

faq.q: I am a tenant farmer — am I eligible?
faq.a: Tenant farmers whose names are not recorded in land records are generally not covered. You must have your name in the state land records.

faq.q: My land is in my father's name — can I get PM-KISAN?
faq.a: The benefit is per family, not per individual. If your father is already receiving it as the head of the family, other members do not get separate benefits.

faq.q: I received only one installment — what about the rest?
faq.a: Check your status on pmkisan.gov.in. It may be due to Aadhaar seeding issues or bank account validation problems.

faq.q: How do I update my bank account details?
faq.a: Visit your local agriculture department office or CSC with Aadhaar and new bank details to update your records.
